title: Triage routing - promote inbox items into projects with provenance
description: WHY: capture without routing is a junk drawer; routing is where an unassigned note becomes accountable work in the right place. WHAT: extend the raw-inbox triage flow with global routing actions: promote <raw-id> --to <project-id> --as work|source|claim|decision creates the target record inside the linked project workspace (write through that project store with its own locking), attaches a provenance sourceRef pointing back at the global capture via its boreal URI (sprint G3), and marks the global raw item reconciled with a forward reference; keep-global converts to a global record; drop tombstones with a reason. Routing to a paused or archived project is refused with a typed error naming the lifecycle state. Update the boreal-raw-inbox workflow and skill so agents run triage sessions against the global inbox.
acceptanceCriteria: Promote creates the record in the target project with a provenance reference resolving back to the capture, covered by an end-to-end test across two workspaces
Keep-global and drop paths work and the inbox item state reflects the outcome
Routing to an archived project is refused with a typed error
